name: eRoyal IMPEX
tagline: Smart Customs Filing for Faster Global Trade
shortDescription: eRoyal IMPEX is a cloud-based ICEGATE customs filing software that helps customs brokers, importers, exporters, and logistics providers simplify Shipping Bills, Bills of Entry, customs documentation, and regulatory compliance through one secure platform.

banner.tagline: Smart Customs Filing for Faster Global Trade
banner.description: Simplify Shipping Bills, Bills of Entry, and ICEGATE filing with a secure cloud-based customs management platform built for customs brokers, importers, exporters, and logistics professionals.

features.heading: Everything You Need for Seamless Customs Filing
features.description: Powerful tools designed to simplify customs documentation, improve visibility, and streamline import and export operations.

items.title: ICEGATE Filing Automation
items.description: Simplify Shipping Bill and Bill of Entry filing through seamless ICEGATE integration. Create, validate, submit, and manage customs declarations while reducing manual effort and improving filing accuracy.

items.title: Secure Document Management
items.description: Upload, organize, and securely manage Shipping Bills, Bills of Entry, invoices, declarations, and supporting customs documents from one centralized platform.

items.title: Real-Time Filing Tracking
items.description: Track the status of every customs filing in real time, helping your team reduce delays, improve visibility, and manage import-export operations more efficiently.

sez.heading: Special Economic Zone (SEZ) Customs Filing
sez.description: eRoyal IMPEX SEZ is a dedicated module built for businesses operating within Special Economic Zones (SEZs). It simplifies SEZ customs documentation, streamlines import and export filing workflows, and helps organizations maintain compliance with evolving SEZ regulations.

features.title: SEZ Bill of Entry Filing
features.description: Digitally prepare and manage Bill of Entry transactions specifically designed for SEZ customs procedures.

features.title: SEZ Shipping Bill Management
features.description: Simplify Shipping Bill filing for SEZ exports while reducing documentation complexity and manual processing.

features.title: Automated SEZ Documentation
features.description: Generate and organize SEZ customs documents through standardized digital workflows for improved operational efficiency.

features.title: Regulatory Compliance
features.description: Stay aligned with the latest SEZ customs procedures through continuous software updates and compliance enhancements.

benefits: Purpose-built for Special Economic Zone operations
Integrated with eRoyal IMPEX customs workflows

counter.description: Shipments managed every day with efficient customs filing, documentation, and import-export workflows.

targetAudience.description: Whether you're filing customs declarations, managing cross-border shipments, or coordinating logistics operations, eRoyal IMPEX provides a faster, smarter way to manage ICEGATE filing, streamline customs documentation, ensure regulatory compliance, and simplify import-export workflows—all from one secure cloud-based platform.
